name: Computer Training Scheme for Visually Impaired Persons
benefit:
**Computer Training with Screen-Reading Software**

- Two-month intensive computer training is provided using screen-reading software.
- Training is conducted in two batches daily, each of four hours.
- Training is delivered in seven divisions: Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, Sagar, Rewa, and Ujjain.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must have 40% or more visual impairment. 1. The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household. 1. The applicant must have passed class 8th with at least 50% marks.1. The applicant is eligible to receive training only once under this scheme.
